title: Two boards forget their starts
notes: Keep one adult at each table to read tickets and record a child-chosen story. First routes: K-1 P1-3; grades 2-3 P1-3; grades 4-5 P1-3. On return, K-1 can contrast chosen universal repairs with random repeats (P4-7). Grades 2-3 can separate the no-deadline claim (P4-5) from toggles and mixed stories (P6-7). Grades 4-5 can prove the mixed-story criterion (P4-5), then explain the last-assignment color distribution (P6-7). Preserve visited markers as a record of assignments, not a tally of visible changes.
